ev.q: Data from the Paul Coverdell National Acute Stroke Registry were analyzed from the 142 hospitals participating in the four registry states
A total of 2,275 (65.2%) received imaging within 1 hour of ED arrival.
the proportion of patients who arrived at the ED within 2 hours of symptom onset was used
Among those patients who arrived at the ED within 2 hours, the median time from ED arrival to brain imaging was 0.73 hours
fewer than half (48.0%) of stroke patients for whom onset data were available arrived at the ED within 2 hours
Significantly fewer blacks or African Americans (42.4%) arrived within 2 hours of symptom onset compared with whites (49.5%)
the results represent aggregate data from four states and are neither a random sample of stroke patients or hospitals

methods_quotes.q: The chi-square test was used to examine the significance of differences in characteristics
